author: ESPN / UFC (photographer not credited)
notes: Official UFC studio headshot, frontal, neutral expression, flat studio flash. Best frontal face reference: buzz cut with squared, lined-up hairline, straight brows, long straight nose, light stubble shadow. 600x436 only.

author: ESPN / UFC (photographer not credited)
notes: Full-body studio cut-out, black Venum/crypto.com fight kit (2021-2024 era), arms down, slight three-quarter. Physique reference. No forearm tattoo visible in this shoot (the right-forearm piece seen in later photos is either newer or turned away).

author: ESPN / UFC (photographer not credited)
notes: Full-body studio cut-out, white Venum kit with grey tiger-stripe print and 'KARA-FRANCE' down the left leg. Shows the black Polynesian-style tattoo on the outer right forearm. Best physique reference (abs, shoulders, forearms, legs).

author: Cageside Press (photographer not named on the page)
notes: UFC 317 ceremonial weigh-in face-off with Alexandre Pantoja (Kara-France on the right, tongue out). Near-profile of his left side plus most of his back: the large black-and-grey Polynesian/Maori-style piece over the right shoulder blade is clearly visible. Pounamu-style pendant cord around the neck.

author: Cageside Press (UFC press-conference video still)
notes: UFC 305 (Perth) post-fight press conference, frontal, neutral face, grey beanie covering the hair. Good for the eyes, nose, mouth and jaw under even light.

author: Cageside Press (UFC broadcast still)
notes: UFC 305 ceremonial weigh-in face-off with Steve Erceg, right-side profile, biceps flex, tongue out. Shows the right-side shaved part line, the dark green pounamu (adze-shaped) pendant on a black cord, and that no tattoo shows on the front of the right shoulder or upper arm.

author: Getty Images (Zuffa LLC; photographer not credited on the page), Getty ID 2222688087
notes: UFC 317 vs Pantoja, Kara-France on the left in white Venum shorts taking a jab. Right-side view of head (fade, shaved part line, ear), right-forearm tattoo, top edge of the back tattoo on the right shoulder. Most recent fight photo.

author: UFC / Zuffa LLC (credited 'UFC' on the page)
notes: UFC 317, Pantoja's rear-naked choke from the back; Kara-France's face in three-quarter view, slightly low angle. Small (660x441).

author: Getty Images (Zuffa LLC), Getty ID 2167218942
notes: UFC 305 vs Steve Erceg, Kara-France from behind throwing a right hand, black Venum shorts. Clearest view of the back tattoo: wide wing/manaia-like Polynesian design with koru curls and a row of shark-tooth (niho mano) triangles along its lower edge, spanning from the base of the neck across the right shoulder blade toward the back of the right shoulder.

author: Jeff Bottari / Zuffa LLC via Getty Images (ID 2167219237)
notes: UFC 305 cage-side close-up, near-frontal with head turned slightly to his left, eyes wide and tongue out (pre-fight ritual face). High resolution: skin texture, eye colour, brows, nose shape, buzz cut and hairline; tattoo linework visible on the trapezius at the lower right of frame.

author: 1News / TVNZ (agency not credited)
notes: Celebrating the KO of Cody Garbrandt (UFC 269, Dec 2021), arms spread, torso frontal, black kit, purple stage light on one side. Good for chest, abs, arm length; older (2021), before the forearm tattoo was visible.
